entry.name: oscbank~
entry.description: oscbank~ is a non-interpolating oscillator bank with signal inputs to set oscillator frequency and magnitude.

arguments.name: frequency-smoothing-factor (samples)
arguments.description: The number of samples across which frequency smoothing is done.

arguments.name: amplitude-smoothing-factor (samples)
arguments.description: The number of samples across which amplitude smoothing is done.

arguments.name: lookup-table-size (samples)
arguments.description: The size, in samples, of the sinewave lookup table used by theobject. The default is 4096. Sinceuses uninterpolated oscillators, you can choose to use a sinetable of larger size at the expense of CPU.Note: There is only one wavetable for all oscillators in a givenobject,

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: The wordsets the frequency of all oscillators to zero and zeros all amplitudes.
messages.description: The wordsets the frequency of all oscillators to zero and zeros all amplitudes.

messages.name: copybuf
messages.digest: In left inlet: The word, followed by a symbol that specifies a buffer, copies samples from the buffer into theobject's internal wavetable.
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a symbol that specifies a buffer, copies samples from the buffer into theobject's internal wavetable. The number of samples is set using themessage. An optional second integer argument specifies the position in the buffer at which samples are loaded (offset).

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: Sets the frequency of the oscillator whose index is currently referenced to the current floating-point value of the signal. The default value is 0.In 2nd inlet: Sets the magnitude (amplitude) of the oscillator whose index is currently referenced.In 3rd inlet: Ifis enabled using themessage, a value in the range 0-1.0 sets the phase of the oscillator currently being referenced.In 4th inlet: Sets the index of the oscillator currently being referenced.

messages.name: framesync
messages.digest: The word, followed by a non-zero number, enables frame synchronous operation. When frame synchronous operation is enabled, a given index's values will only change or begin their interpolated ramps to the next value when the index input signal is 0 (or once per n sample frame).
messages.description: The word, followed by a non-zero number, enables frame synchronous operation. When frame synchronous operation is enabled, a given index's values will only change or begin their interpolated ramps to the next value when the index input signal is 0 (or once per n sample frame). Otherwise, a given index's values will change or begin their interpolated ramps to the next value when the index input signal is equal to that index. The default is off.

messages.name: freqsmooth
messages.digest: The word, followed by an, sets the number of samples across which frequency smoothing is done.
messages.description: The word, followed by an, sets the number of samples across which frequency smoothing is done. The default is(no smoothing).

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Performs the same function asin any inlet (seeandmessages).
messages.description: Performs the same function asin any inlet (seeandmessages).

messages.name: magsmooth
messages.digest: The word, followed by an, sets the number of samples across which magnitude (amplitude)
messages.description: The word, followed by an, sets the number of samples across which magnitude (amplitude) smoothing is done on a oscillator. The default is(no amplitude smoothing).

messages.name: set
messages.digest: The word, followed by pairs of floating-point values, sets the frequency and amplitude of an oscillator in the oscillator bank.
messages.description: The word, followed by pairs of floating-point values, sets the frequency and amplitude of an oscillator in the oscillator bank. A list of n pairs will set the first n oscillators in theobject and zero the amplitude of all others.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: Sets the frequency of the oscillator whose index is currently referenced to the current floating-point value of the signal. The default value is 0.In 2nd inlet: Sets the magnitude (amplitude) of the oscillator whose index is currently referenced.In 3rd inlet: Ifis enabled using themessage, a signal in the range 0-1.0 sets the phase of the oscillator currently being referenced.In 4th inlet: Sets the index of the oscillator currently being referenced.

messages.name: silence
messages.digest: The wordzeros the amplitude of all the oscillators.
messages.description: The wordzeros the amplitude of all the oscillators.

messages.name: size
messages.digest: The word, followed by a number, sets the number of oscillators.
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the number of oscillators. The default is 64. The maximum number of oscillators is set by the argument first argument to the object.

messages.name: tabpoints
messages.digest: The word, followed by a number, sets the number of wavetable points (samples)
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the number of wavetable points (samples) in theobject's internal wavetable. The default is 4096. The number of wavetable points should be a power or two between 2and 2. Any other value will be rounded to the nearest power of two.
